public.title: Reverse Nodes in k-Group
public.description: The array encodes a singly linked list in head-to-tail order. Reverse each full consecutive group of k nodes and leave a final shorter group unchanged. Return the resulting values. This value-only adaptation does not check node identity or in-place rewiring. Length is 0 to 1000, k is 1 to 1000, and values are integers between -10000 and 10000.
hints: Check group length before reversing it.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Copy full groups in reverse and preserve the final partial group. O(n) time and output space.
